craft_notes: Sthāyin: wherever-joy. va (indeed) vs vā (or) guarded. Close: established. Rejected: 'wherever you go' address — killed: step kept; 'explodes' — killed: stands kept.

lines: Angry, thrilled, or 'what shall I do?' — or musing, on the run:
whatever step it takes, there spanda stands established.
l4.sanskrit_cite: atikruddhaḥ prahṛṣṭo vā kiṃ karomīti vā mṛśan | dhāvan va yat padaṃ gacchet tatra spandaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ
